title: Inside a Secret Chinese Bitcoin Mine
summary: Motherboard's 2014 visit to a secretive Bitcoin mining operation in a repurposed factory in Liaoning, China, one of six sites producing about 4,050 bitcoins a month. It shows the machines and the workers' living conditions.
why: HN links it as a rare look inside a large Chinese mining operation, with its deafening machine noise and workers' conditions.

quote.text: The noise of these machines is incredibly loud and annoying even in the edited video
